name: trill-tuner
description: Trill Tuner — a complete guitar companion: from-scratch YIN tuner with strobe + poly strum check, 94 tunings, metronome with jam tracks, recorder, lyric search (artist OR title), a play-along song library, a tab maker that listens to any song and tells you the chords, key, tempo and capo to play it, a stem lab that removes or isolates the vocals, drums, bass, electric and acoustic guitar of a track, a live accuracy listener that tells you when you play the wrong note, a learning academy, practice studio, advanced toolkit, virtual amplifier + pedalboard (52 amps, 125 pedals, 26 famous rigs), progress sharing, backups and guitar care.

scripts.test: node test/yin-test.js && node test/poly-test.js && node test/dsp-test.js && node test/songs-test.js
